notes: Clicking a release shows you something now. The player only opens once the start and the end of the file have arrived, because a video cannot be opened without both, and that rule was completely silent: clicking put nothing on screen, sometimes for a minute, so the only reasonable conclusion was that the click had not registered. There is now a panel with the state, how many people you are connected to, the speed, progress, and a Stop. Episodes also have their real titles, summaries, air dates and screenshots: they were coming from MyAnimeList alone, which times out often enough that a whole series would read Untitled all the way down and which carries no pictures at all, so AniSol now also reads the episode guide mapped from the AniList id.
